snippet.title: HELIX - Official Features Overview
snippet.description:
Take a look behind the development of HELIX - the ultimate open-world multiplayer sandbox game.
Signup for Closed Alpha at https://helixgame.com/
Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/helixgame
Twitter: https://x.com/play_helix

HELIX is the Ultimate Open-World Multiplayer Sandbox Game.  Powered by Unreal Engine 5, HELIX is the first sandbox game specifically designed for roleplay (RP) and modding.
